scope: Recover prior sources and units only; no new molecular panel, configuration, native execution, build, parameter edit or field outcome.

prior_execution_status.previous_executed_controls: Zero-field native moment/energy admission and 18383 zero-field identity/gradient qualification only. Neither establishes finite-field correctness.

reusable_components.quantum: Existing exact full-parent trimer and shared-dimer SP inputs/zero energies, frozen common-basis masks and ECP/auxiliary assets, quantum_moment raw/property reader and origin/effective-charge evidence.
reusable_components.model: Original installed analyze with EM, unchanged frozen17676 inputs, RUN_v2.induced_file and parse_moments, exact site/type/frame admission, strict energy parser, and all-summary induction residual checks.
reusable_components.avoid: No standalone polarize executable/build; no reuse of old scope/release gates; no new correction added to native external-induced energy.

units_and_sign.quantum_field: EField in atomic units; physical positive-z field. E(F)=E0-mu*F-alpha*F^2/2+... . Explicit field origin and dipole origin zero.
units_and_sign.quantum_origin: Input origin follows geometry input units; actual printed Position of electric origin is Bohr. Real Dy ZA11, ghost ZA/mass0. Use full-precision property moments or retain printed-origin bounds.
units_and_sign.model_field: EXTERNAL-FIELD in MV/cm, divided by elefield; added to both direct field arrays.
units_and_sign.dual_field_caveat: General dual AMOEBA derivative uses permanent plus half(uind+uinp). Complete-water fragment graphs have equal direct/energy permanent scaling (intrawater zero, unbonded other pairs unity); retain this scoped source equality and check energy/moment agreement, rather than generalizing to protein graphs.
units_and_sign.charged_origin: Native model printed moment is COM based; lab moment equals printed + D*Q*COM_A. Signed dipole differences at fixed coordinates cancel this constant. The same-charge conditional total moment is origin independent only after using one shared origin for both fragments.

prototype_guard.source: source_v5/damping.f:1132-1137 includes use_exfld in unsupported modes; source_v5/induce.f:42 invokes guard if npairdm!=0.
prototype_guard.activation: kpolar.f:588-589 increments npairdm for any nonzero D or M record, even if its types are absent; absent/all-zero records retain old route.
prototype_guard.conclusion: Use original baseline engine for this diagnostic. Do not remove guard or infer field support from zero-field18383 or physical18413.

prospective_constraints_sent_to_root_and.accepted_proposed_question: One W9 far waters1/3 metal-two-water trimer and exact M-water1 dimer, each metal, signed h and h/2:16 quantum SPs and16 matching baseline model field calls; conditional environment increment, not alpha3 or fullB.
prospective_constraints_sent_to_root_and.qualification: Apply energy-vs-moment and two-step comparisons to each of four systems and directly to both increments and paired contrast. Keep both steps, all vectors, SCF stopping criteria and final-integration corrections. Failure remains failure; no automatic field/tolerance retry.

precision_floor_at_smaller_step.meaning: Printing floors only, not induction or SCF accuracy bounds.

prospective_constraints_sent_to_root_and.minimal_extra_model_controls_recommended: One explicit-zero-field identity on a consumed trimer plus ±h on one existing bare ion at the metal-origin, checking mu_ind=alpha*f and deltaE=-K*alpha*f^2/2. Together with16 matched calls gives19 baseline analyze calls; root must declare actual count. No prototype or field-force work.
prospective_constraints_sent_to_root_and.zero_reference_reuse: Reuse actual same-parent trimer/dimer SP zero energies and matching energy stages, not the old full-cluster EnGrad anchors from the earlier feasibility proposal.
prospective_constraints_sent_to_root_and.limits: Prospective .5/1 alpha-unit gates are chosen diagnostic numerical resolution, not physical reference accuracy or an SCF energy-error certificate. A directional increment is not an irreducible three-body polarizability, isotropic response, unique mechanism, or force qualification.

cost.cost_scope: Receipt generation only; source-reading command wall times are in session tool receipts.
